newsitem.title: UK: Syria agrees to buy 100,000 t Aug gas oil - trade.
newsitem.headline: Syria agrees to buy 100,000 t Aug gas oil - trade.

text.p: Syria has agreed to buy a total of 100,000 tonnes of 0.7 percent sulphur gas oil at premiums of around $9.50 to $9.75 above the fob Med mean quotations, traders said on Wednesday.
The premiums agreed with German trader Stinnes and Swiss trader Onyx Oil were slightly higher than anticipated, they said.
Onyx was awarded a 25,000 tonne cargo for late July and another for first half August. Stinnes has two 25,000-tonners for second half August.
